g.text: You're free. You can leave. Go anywhere. Anywhere but *here.*
We're the past. Dead and gone.
Just pieces of a memory or bits of data in one of Amir's games.
We don't matter anymore. And maybe we never did.
Why would you ever keep coming back, when you had the choice to leave?!
The pizza is great. So, I like the food?
For you. For us. For what we have.
I don't have time for this. [End.]
The pizza is great. So, I like the food?
If you'd prefer I leave, then just tell me.
Do you think I'm just here with you, what, killing time?!
Only important person in a world of might-as-well-be-corpses? Charming.
Don't put words in my mouth.
Arthur. I *care* about you. I care about all the of the Hex, but you most of all.
You can do better than that.
I like it here. End of story. End of conversation. [End.]
Why're you so angry at me?
I'm sorry I want to be your friend?
But it's not a serious question. How could you ask me that?
So of *course* I stay here with you!
Sol's sake, let that go! And don't change the subject.
Stop dodging! Why. Are. You. Still. Here?!
You have something I never have. Freedom.
It's obvious why I'm here. For *you.* For the Hex. Because you're my family.
How can you even ask me that?
Or are we like pets to you? Some sort of sideshow attraction maybe?
Because you matter to me more than I can put into words.
So I can't leave you behind. This place. This time. With *you?*
Because despite the fact it didn't work out between us, I still *care* about you and the rest of the Hex like family.
Because I still have feelings for you, that's why!
Because I have feelings for you, you ASSHAT.
I keep coming back because I...have feelings for you.
You want to know why?! Because you're the first FAMILY I've ever had!
So what is it? Pity? Or are you stupid as well as crazy?
So, no. This place, this time? With *you,* Arthur? This is my home.
It's the first place that's ever...felt like home.
If caring makes me crazy, or stupid, so be it.
My temper's always been my worst enemy. Let me make it up to you over a pint?
How can you be telling me this, while you're stringing someone else along?!
That's why I keep coming back. Because that's what family *does.*
I owe you a pint, love. And one of those pizzas.
I... sometimes try to find enemies where there aren't any. And I... didn't realize how much we meant to you.
How much I meant to you. And that's on me. C'mon. Let's go get a drink.
But I owe you an apology, love... And a pint.
Yep, sounds just like family to me...
If you don't tell Eleanor soon, she'll find out on her own.
After what you've pulled? That won't work on me.
But if you want to give this another go, we should talk this though in person.
That's all you've got to say?
I've got to go think for a bit.
I... sometimes try to find enemies where there aren't any. And I... didn't realize how much we meant to you.
For your own safety I'd recommend telling her. But just so you know?
You need to tell Amir. It's not fair to him.
How much I meant to you. And that's on me. C'mon. Let's go get a drink.
I accepted you leaving me for the better twin, but... this? There'll be no taking you back.
He's got enough to cope with as it is without dealing with your games.
Do you know how rare it is for Quincy to trust someone? To really let someone in?
No - I mean - I need to go think. I'm sorry.
Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurConfession.
You're proving all his worst suspicions about the world right.
Lettie's supposed to be with someone who helps share the burden.
Not bloody add to to the pain.
Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurAsshat.
